messages:
Marta: hey folks, small docs PR touching SDK examples + migration guide — CI preview failing link-checker. can someone grab reviewer?
Raj: I can take it but I'm oncall til 11:30 PT. is it blocking a release?
Marta: not release-blocking but affects onboarding snippets, want it merged before EOD. link-checker flags a relative path in migration.md and a missing code fence in python snippet.
Sam: if it's just link + fence i can patch quickly, but want an approval for the migration rationale from someone who touched the migration guide last. @Kai?
Kai: I wrote that section last quarter. i'm OOO until 3pm but can give a quick skim after.
Marta: ok fallback rule needed — who is the tiebreaker when primary reviewer is OOO? could we use rotation-owner or next-in-rotation?
Raj: agreed, current rotation list is sparse today. propose: if primary is OOO, assign to the last editor in the file blame; else next person in docs-rotation.
Sam: I'm happy to open a small PR with the fixes and mark for Kai review. then Raj can approve if Kai doesn't respond by 3:30.
docs-ci-bot: preview build failed — link-checker error in migration.md: './deprecated-apis' -> 404.
Marta: Sam, please push your quickfix branch with fixes + note in PR body the suggested tiebreaker. I'll add label 'docs:merge-window' and schedule merge at 16:00 PT.
Sam: pushed branch fix/migration-link-fence, PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823
Kai: pinged — will try to look at 15:10 PT and leave comment. if no comment by 15:30 Raj can approve.
Raj: thanks, i'll monitor and approve if needed.
Marta: resolving here into action items: 1) Sam fix and push (done), 2) Marta add label + schedule merge at 16:00 PT, 3) Kai review by 15:30 else Raj approves, 4) update rotation doc to include blame-based fallback.
Sam: sounds good :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks all — closing thread once merged.
